SUMMARY
- 4 read-only GET probes fired (~1/s), then stopped. Cap 8; halted at 4 (no
  further pure-GET reads possible without a valid ASN id, and no 401/403/429/WAF hit).
- KEY EVIDENCE: token is VALID (no 401) — the ASN service answered with structured
  JSON. GET /api/v1/asn/list and /api/v1/asn/filter both returned
  {"success":false,...,"error":{"message":"No ASN found for asn number: <list|filter>"}}
  => the server routes GET /api/v1/asn/{anything} to the by-id handler
  (getAsnDetailsById). So GET_ASN_LISTING ("api/v1/asn/filter") and
  GET_ASN_SUMMARY_LIST ("api/v1/asn/list") are almost certainly invoked as POST
  with a {filters}/paging body in the app (the "GET_" prefix is a naming
  convention, not the HTTP verb) — method to confirm.
- /api/v1/asn/user/mh-list and /user/vendor-list => "404 page not found" (plain,
  not the ASN-service JSON) — those filter paths need the app's x-proxy-target
  routing (the proven Sales flow sends x-proxy-target: brand-analytics); the ASN
  filter-list proxy target was not guessed (no blind POST/target fuzzing).
- 2xx PROVEN: 0. All ASN endpoints remain DOCUMENTED (not proven). Re-run once a
  valid ASN id + the correct method/x-proxy-target are captured from a live grid.
